businessInfo.name: 我的意思是要调研我们

subject: Merge capability inventory + vanilla surface into roadmap
description: Two research agents are enumerating (a) what this project actually implements today with file:line evidence and FULL/PARTIAL/STUB/ABSENT tags, and (b) the measured vanilla 26.2 feature surface from the official client jar (blockstates/multipart counts, item models, recipe types, biomes, structures + jigsaw templates, entity types, enchantments, GUI sprites, lang keys, sound events, worldgen pipeline size, particle types). Merge both into a prioritized implementation roadmap with dependencies and S/M/L/XL effort, then create one task per roadmap milestone.
